videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Sharon, Tracey and Dorien manage to convince themselves Princess Diana has bought a local mansion, and enthusiastically prepare for the arrival of royal neighbours - will their attempts to raise Chigwell's social standing end in tears? Comedy, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Tracey is disturbed when her son falls for an older woman, but when his mother and new girlfriend discover how much they have in common, Garth is the one left feeling disconcerted.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Tracey rings a local radio station with advice for a grieving widow and ends up becoming the airwaves' latest agony aunt _ but can she pluck up the courage to admit she'll only be a 'widow' herself for as long as Her Majesty pleases? Comedy, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph.

videos.title: Lovejoy
videos.description: Tinker and Lovejoy set out to unravel the meaning behind a strange carving of a Japanese firefly cage, helped by Lady Jane Felsham. Drama, starring Ian McShane.

videos.title: Lovejoy
videos.description: An overzealous taxman sets out to snare Lovejoy - not to mention an axe-wielding jailbird determined to retrieve an ornate Arab head-dress. Drama, starring Ian McShane and Dudley Sutton.

videos.title: Lovejoy
videos.description: Charlie Gimbert plans an elaborate double-cross to get his hands on a pair of valuable Meissen figurines, sold to Lovejoy by a woman who needed some quick cash to buy drugs. Drama, starring Ian McShane.

videos.title: Call the Midwife
videos.description: Everyone is looking forward to Trixie and Matthew's wedding and a bonny baby competition brings the community together. It's not all good news, however, as the team learn about a pregnant woman and her family living in a cramped caravan, while a worrying disease outbreak directly impacts the residents of Nonnatus House.

videos.title: Pie in the Sky
videos.description: Crabbe helps the owners of a local Chinese takeaway whose pride and takings are steadily being eroded by racist attacks, while the Great British Grub competition looks set to be a roaring success. Comedy drama, starring Richard Griffiths and Maggie Steed.

videos.title: Pie in the Sky
videos.description: Crabbe agrees to cook for a reluctant witness in a police safe house, and comes under threat from both a ruthless villain and an unscrupulous copper. Meanwhile, Henderson is alarmed by an unwelcome reminder of a past indiscretion. Comedy drama, starring Richard Griffiths.

videos.title: Pie in the Sky
videos.description: A luncheon given by the area's new police caterers for local bigwigs is sabotaged, leaving Crabbe spoiled for choice when it comes to suspects. Detective drama, starring Richard Griffiths, Maggie Steed and Malcolm Sinclair.

videos.title: The Marlow Murder Club
videos.description: After a revered member of the sailing club is brutally bludgeoned to death, Judith, Becks and Suzie navigate simmering grudges within the tight-knit community.

videos.title: The Marlow Murder Club
videos.description: Motives stack up against the suspects, Kit's killer sends another violent warning and Judith, Becks and Suzie are in a race against time to solve the case.

videos.title: The Brokenwood Mysteries
videos.description: Alzheimer sufferer Edward Alderston comes under suspicion of involvement when an ex-finance company high-flyer responsible for the loss of many elderly people's life savings is found floating in a swimming pool with a samurai sword in his back.

videos.title: Father Brown
videos.description: A mysterious saboteur tries to stop Kembleford winning the Three Counties choir competition. Return of the 1950s-set crime drama based on the stories by GK Chesterton, starring Mark Williams as the Roman Catholic priest who attempts to solve various misdemeanours.

videos.title: The Red King
videos.description: After a body is discovered, Grace is convinced something sinister is at play - but the mainland police disagree. Was Cai's death accidental or is there a murderer loose on St. Jory?

videos.title: Rebus
videos.description: While Rebus looks into the apparent suicide of a man at an investment bank, Clarke investigates a stabbing on the seedy Westmills estate. The inspector learns his victim had links to a chemical company building a new plant in the area, as well as an Angolan village where children have been used unscrupulously in drug testing - but before his latest informant can pass on vital evidence, she too is silenced. Drama, starring Ken Stott and Claire Price.

videos.description: Crabbe agrees to cook for a reluctant witness in a police safe house, and comes under threat from both a ruthless villain and an unscrupulous copper. Meanwhile, Henderson is alarmed by an unwelcome reminder of a past indiscretion. Comedy drama, starring Richard Griffiths.

videos.title: Harry Wild
videos.description: A man from Orla's past begs for her help as he is on the run from the police after being framed for murder, and being hunted by a killer with a crossbow.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Sharon joins a video dating agency and asks Darren to shoot a rehearsal tape, while Garth buys tickets for a Rolling Stones concert.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: As CID's search for the rapist intensifies, Spears, Clarke and Page volunteer to act as bait, posing as prostitutes in the local park in the hope of attracting his attention. However, Spears soon has cause to worry when DS Cork, who is supposed to be guarding her, disappears from sight. Fourth of a six-part story, starring Tania Emery, Libby Davison and Tristan Gemmill.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Hotel rep Tommy Lawson threatens to blackmail Klein unless he provides an alibi, and Spears resolves to watch Cork every step of the way after he breaks into her room for a 'friendly' drink. Events prove her theory correct _ but none of the team anticipates the full horror unfolding in the rape case. Fifth in a six-part story, starring Tania Emery and Tristan Gemmill.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Conclusion of the six-part story. As Cork's life hangs in the balance, Kate Spears comes face to face with Sun Hill's serial rapist, but events soon spiral out of control when he starts taking hostages, and capturing him proves far from easy. Beat-pounding drama, starring Tania Emery, Libby Davison and Michael McKell.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Polly Page investigates the mysterious disappearance of a woman who later turns out to be the bigamous wife of two violent ex-convicts - and discovers she may have done a bunk to Spain with the loot from a robbery. Lisa Geoghan stars.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: New arrival Special Constable Knowles joins Sun Hill, but soon comes under the bad influence of corrupt copper Taviner, while tension mounts as Singh and Riley attempt to resolve a feud between neighbours which threatens to escalate out of control. Beat-pounding drama, starring Alex Avery, Paul Usher and Jeff Stewart.

videos.title: Tenko
videos.description: First episode of the Second World War drama set in a Japanese PoW camp holding only female inmates, with the pampered British inhabitants of Singapore blissfully unaware of the looming onslaught of the Japanese. Stephanie Beacham and Ann Bell star.

videos.title: Tenko
videos.description: Japanese forces advance on Singapore as the end of 1941 draws near, but its civilian population remains blithely unconcerned. Far Eastern war drama, with Ann Bell, Jeananne Crowley and Stephanie Beacham.

videos.title: Catherine Cookson's A Dinner of Herbs
videos.description: First in a two-part drama, starring Billie Whitelaw as a herbalist who takes an 11-year-old orphan under her wing. The youngster soon makes friends with a local girl and the future looks rosy - but heartbreak is waiting just around the corner. With Tim Healy, Jonathan Kerrigan and Michael Jayston.

videos.title: Little Dorrit
videos.description: The Dorrits finally leave Marshalsea, where they meet Rigaud and the Gowans. Amy continues to struggle to adapt to her new wealthy status while Arthur throws himself into work.

videos.title: Little Dorrit
videos.description: Fanny and Edmund continue their liaison despite the efforts of Mrs Merdle, while Arthur meets Rigaud and uncovers his dark past.

videos.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries
videos.description: As Great Slaughter's Quincentennial Celebrations near, Sister Helena is found dead in the chapel having been bludgeoned over the head.

videos.title: Silent Witness
videos.description: A small town trying to look to the future is hit by a devastating train crash, leaving the forensic team to work with the police and counter-terrorism officers to piece together what happened. With a dead mayor on their hands, they are keen to find a motive, and the family who own the land might very well hold the key. Meanwhile, Jack's family life gets more complicated.

videos.title: New Tricks
videos.description: The team reopens a 20-year-old case when a camera and film belonging to a photographic lab assistant murdered in 1987 are found by chance in a Soho pub toilet. New evidence leads the detectives into the world of modelling and to the door of a professional footballer. Meanwhile, Brian's erratic behaviour takes an alarming turn, and Gerry is less than happy when his daughter Emily (played by Dennis Waterman's real-life daughter Hannah) joins the team and looks to Sandra as a role model.

videos.description: Dorien may have ulterior motives for inviting Tracey to a posh event, while Sharon makes a tidy profit out of fake Rolling Stones T-shirts. Comedy, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph.

videos.description: Harry, Lola and Fergus are the guests of honour at a weekend-long 1920s themed murder mystery party at a hotel on a secluded island. But as a ferry arrives to take them to the island, over at the hotel the head chef is bludgeoned to death in his own kitchen.

videos.description: As maverick copper Taviner is relegated to desk duties in a bid to keep him in line, his protege Knowles has a difference of opinion with Stamp over a father denied access to his children - an argument that boils over during an incident involving a damaged car. Fortunately, voice of reason Hollis is on hand to calm them down before events turn nasty. Long-running police drama, starring Paul Usher, Alex Avery and Graham Cole.

videos.title: Classic Doctors
videos.description: Cherry is given the opportunity to bring her ordeal to a close and say her final farewells when she attends Scott's funeral. However, she must first face a few home truths. Sophie Abelson stars.

videos.title: Classic Doctors
videos.description: As everyone nervously awaits the outcome for Jimmi in the radio awards, Lily meets an old flame, and Julia's preparations to entertain Liam's family go awry when only Ocean and Martin turn up. Medical drama, starring Adrian Lewis Morgan and Seeta Indrani.

videos.title: Classic Holby City
videos.description: Jac learns a consultant's post is available on Keller, but her hopes take a battering when she discovers Lady Byrne is on the interviewing panel. Sam takes advantage of Maddy by dumping baby Grace on her while he goes out with agency nurse Zoe. Elliot catches James rifling through his wallet, but Mark is about to discover the surgeon's son is involved in a more serious criminal act.

videos.title: Casualty
videos.description: Connie's old boss Andrea returns to the ED as the specialist doctor to a young heart patient, and her insistence that the boy should be operated on, despite his obvious weakness, makes Connie suspicious of her motives. A young man sneaks into the department, deeply distressed by a huge abscess in his mouth, and Lofty becomes concerned for his mental health. Dixie's nose is put out of joint by Tamzin and Jeff's relationship, claiming she doesn't trust Tamzin - but is it just jealousy? videos.description: Zainab is left terrified when Yusef reveals his true colours in a shocking showdown while Masood has a proposition for Jane. Amira homes in on an unsuspecting Syed.

videos.description: Phil is unnerved to receive another mysterious photograph from an anonymous source, and turns to Pat when events take a darker turn. Zainab confronts Yusef.

videos.title: Classic Neighbours
videos.description: Des leaves the wedding for a wander, thinking Daphne has jilted him. In the aftermath of the hold up, the police are after people dressed in gorilla costumes.

videos.title: Classic Neighbours
videos.description: The Robinsons are expecting Scott to come home. Meanwhile, Helen Daniels has a plan to get back at Douglas Blake after her private detective has tracked him down.

videos.title: Shakespeare & Hathaway: Private Investigators
videos.description: Comedy drama about an oddball couple of private detectives who investigate crime in Stratford-upon-Avon. Frank and Lu are drawn into Stratford's Silicon Valley when Spider calls upon their help to expose a mole within tech company Forosa. Mark Benton and Jo Joyner star.

videos.title: Father Brown
videos.description: After suspicious circumstances surround the death of a local fighter, Father Brown is drawn into the shady world of boxing to try to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Terry and June
videos.description: A supposedly restful weekend at nephew Alan's country pub leaves the couple anxious to get home. Comedy, starring Terry Scott and June Whitfield.

videos.title: Last of the Summer Wine
videos.description: Local PCs Cooper and Walsh try to master a new crime-fighting technique. However, the duo's carefully laid plans unravel when Barry decides to treat a retired vicar to a day trip. Long-running sitcom, starring Ken Kitson and Louis Emerick.

videos.title: Last of the Summer Wine
videos.description: The women of the village are impressed by a series of fanciful tales told by a retired jewel thief about his larcenous exploits in the south of France. However, the scoundrel's skills are put to the test when Marina and Miss Davenport seek his aid in helping Auntie Wainwright crack a keyless safe. John Challis guest stars.

videos.description: When Alvin and Entwistle witness Lance attempting to prove to his wife that Elvis Presley is still alive, the duo feel duty-bound to help him out, and organise for the King himself to make an appearance. Long-running comedy starring Brian Murphy, Burt Kwouk and Kenneth Cope.
